bug_semantics: ClassroomIO loaded a course directly from the browser through Supabase/PostgREST and requested the course's entire group, every groupmember row, and every related profile. An authenticated student could therefore send or alter a request to GET /rest/v1/course with the same bearer token and nested select projection and receive other students' and staff profiles plus course/group metadata; UI role checks did not constitute server-side authorization.
flaw_origin: Commit 60f06d6ab1468dd276ba4b95fe9478d4f95ce3e7 first added src/utils/services/courses/index.js and its browser-side fetchCourse query: .from('course').select(...) included group(*, members:groupmember(*, profile(*))). Its immediate parent has neither that file nor any .from('course') query under src. Later moves and query expansion preserved the same mechanism, while permissive RLS imported in 2023 and course-member RLS added in 2025 failed to distinguish a student from staff when exposing nested course relations.
ai_marker: absent: the raw BIC commit object names human author and committer rotimi-best <best@classroomio.com> and contains only the subject 'Sync with Server'; it has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI trailer.
evidence: First-party issue https://github.com/classroomio/classroomio/issues/642 identifies affected v0.1.13, an authenticated student, GET /rest/v1/course, and disclosure of other student profiles, tutor information, group membership, nested relations, and internal course metadata after method manipulation.

git show 60f06d6ab1468dd276ba4b95fe9478d4f95ce3e7:src/utils/services/courses/index.js shows the newly added fetchCourse calling browser Supabase .from('course').select with group(*), members:groupmember(*), and profile(*), then matching only the attacker-supplied course id; the commit's creation diff adds this file.

Direct parent check: git grep -F ".from('course')" e8c74de9cefbbffb61c674b5fb2ac5ba96775a2b -- src returned no match, and git cat-file -e e8c74de9cefbbffb61c674b5fb2ac5ba96775a2b:src/utils/services/courses/index.js failed because the path does not exist. This proves immediate-parent absence of the vulnerable course loader/projection.

git blame -L 85,140 v0.1.13 -- apps/dashboard/src/lib/utils/services/courses/index.ts traces the then-current ID_QUERY's group(*), members:groupmember(*), and profile(*) lines through later refactoring; inspecting the 2021 file proves the same projection predates those moves.

At v0.1.13, supabase/migrations/20231115082347_remote_schema.sql grants course access and contains CREATE POLICY "Enable access to all users" ... FOR SELECT USING (true), Public profiles are viewable by everyone ... USING (true), and grants on course/groupmember/profile to authenticated. The later supabase/migrations/20250808030821_rls_secure_courses.sql replaces the course policy with is_published OR is_user_in_course_group_or_admin(group_id), which still authorizes the enrolled student described by the issue and does not role-filter nested members.

Version ancestry: git merge-base --is-ancestor 60f06d6ab1468dd276ba4b95fe9478d4f95ce3e7 v0.1.13 succeeded, and git tag --contains lists v0.1.0 through v0.1.13 (and subsequent releases), proving the BIC precedes the affected v0.1.13 boundary. Annotated v0.1.13 peels to 876a785b3c467b809804f56e0981bff448fcfdb5.
Commit bf614fd782d8b9e7d8685e660dfc0a4c981038f1 (tag v0.2.7) first restricted profile SELECT to auth.uid() = id, addressing profile disclosure but not the browser-side course/group query itself.

Commit ac4fdf1dd35772a20899e36f5bf55decb1e0ebda creates /api/courses/data, adds checkUserCoursePermissions, makes getGroupMembers return only [userMembership] for students, and changes CourseContainer from fetchCourse to fetchCourseFromAPI. Its annotated v0.2.8 tag explicitly describes server-side API migration, role-based permission checking, and students seeing only their own data.

Patched boundary: v0.2.7 peels to bf614fd782d8b9e7d8685e660dfc0a4c981038f1 and does not contain ac4fdf1dd35772a20899e36f5bf55decb1e0ebda; v0.2.8 peels exactly to ac4fdf1dd35772a20899e36f5bf55decb1e0ebda and contains the direct fix.

BIC-only AI check: numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1 git cat-file commit 60f06d6ab1468dd276ba4b95fe9478d4f95ce3e7 shows one parent, human author/committer rotimi-best <best@classroomio.com>, and no trailers beyond the plain commit subject.
reasoning: The advisory's response fields match the repository's long-lived nested course projection exactly. History was followed past the 2024 file move/refactor to the first real content addition in 60f06d6ab1468dd276ba4b95fe9478d4f95ce3e7, rather than treating blame's later refactor or the 2023 remote-schema import as the BIC. The BIC put the full course/group/member/profile projection in a browser-held Supabase client; permissive database policies subsequently recorded in Git allowed that projection, and the 2025 course policy still treated any enrolled student as an authorized course member without field/relation-level role filtering. The immediate parent has no course query or course-service file, so absence is directly verified. The BIC is in v0.1.13. The v0.2.7 profile-policy change was partial defense, while v0.2.8's ac4fdf1dd35772a20899e36f5bf55decb1e0ebda is the direct application cutover: it authenticates on the server, verifies course membership/role, and returns only the requesting student's member record to a student. Because the raw BIC commit object has a human author/committer and no AI marker, the BIC-only attribution rule yields NOT_AI.
